file_manifest_format.archive_format: Each results-*.tar or results-*.tar.gz is independently extractable.
file_manifest_format.bundle_exclusions: excluded-*.jsonl.gz are per-bundle. separate_bundle means included there, not globally missing.
file_manifest_format.auxiliary_files: publication_license_notice entries are packaging metadata after cutoff, not experiment outputs.

selection: Serialize the exact original snapshot's canonical eval_json paths, accepted core ROI/embedding index, runtime manifests and terminal/prerequisite evidence. No score-based or latest-mtime retry selection; physical paths are deduplicated within each host.

rights.scope: Noncommercial research dataset-derived result assets; distinct from code licenses

not_published: Raw datasets/input images as standalone data
Credentials, private keys, session stores and unrelated operational logs
Post-cutoff experiment output and unfinished/held output
verification: Recomputed source SHA256 matches the original archive registry. Every provider size and provider MD5 matches the source size and independently computed source MD5. Final scoped project listing has exactly the complete expected file set. Source archives are retained; no cloud MD5 is represented as SHA256.
